summary: SameDay Heating & Air, Plumbing, and Electrical (samedayutah.com) is an Established (Digital Maturity 77/100) active business in Salt Lake City with a very strong public profile (4.8 stars, 10157 reviews) and solid SEO/Accessibility foundations (SEO 92, Accessibility 95, structured data found, GA4 detected). Deterministic audit flags Mobile performance as the main issue: Lighthouse mobile performance: 35/100; largest contentful paint: 15.0s (LCP 14984ms, TBT 2911ms, Interactive 15273ms). One broken internal link was found across 50 checked, and the homepage shows 17 CTA phrases and 86 internal links suggesting potential simplification opportunities.

topOpportunities.title: Fix mobile performance bottleneck (LCP 15.0s)
topOpportunities.evidence: Lighthouse mobile performance: 35/100; largest contentful paint: 15.0s
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Measured Lighthouse mobile performance is 35/100 with LCP 14984ms, Speed Index 9333ms, and Interactive 15273ms. On an emergency-services site with Online booking detected, slow mobile load is a direct friction point. Evidence is high-confidence (Confidence 95, audit Completed 2026-08-22).
topOpportunities.recommendation: Prioritize fixing Largest Contentful Paint and main-thread load. Audit points to 7.7 s main-thread work and 6.9 s JavaScript execution time, 142 KiB unused JavaScript, and render-blocking requests (est savings 220 ms). Implications could include faster mobile first impression if LCP improves, but actual conversion impact not measured in packet.

topOpportunities.title: Repair broken scheduling link
topOpportunities.evidence: Broken internal links: 1 of 50 checked - https://samedayutah.com/schedule status 404
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Site maintenance scored 2 of 4 due to 1 broken of 50 checked. /schedule is likely a high-intent conversion path for an HVAC contractor offering Online estimates.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Fix or redirect /schedule (404) and re-check the remaining links (only 50 of large site checked, crawl truncated at 10 pages). Verify booking/scheduling flow since online booking link is detected separately.

topOpportunities.title: Streamline homepage CTAs and navigation density
topOpportunities.evidence: Homepage CTA phrases detected: 17 and Internal links observed on homepage: 86 with Image alt-text coverage: 93%
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: 17 CTAs and 86 internal links on https://samedayutah.com/ with 0 forms and 0 inputCount on homepage suggests CTAs may be links/buttons to other pages rather than inline conversion. Simplifying could make primary booking/call actions more prominent.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Audit homepage CTAs and internal link density for clarity and prioritization. Consolidate primary actions (e.g., emergency call vs. booking) and ensure alt-text reaches 100% (currently 93% across 14 images).

topOpportunities.title: Address Best Practices and link accessibility flags
topOpportunities.evidence: Links do not have descriptive text: 1 link found and Uses deprecated APIs: 3 warnings found and Elements with an ARIA [role] that require children are missing required children
topOpportunities.whyItMatters: Best Practices 81/100 and specific failures (link-text, deprecations, aria-required-children) are quick wins that improve maintainability and screen-reader experience, even though overall accessibility already scores high.
topOpportunities.recommendation: Fix Lighthouse Best Practices/Accessibility failures: add descriptive text to 1 link, address 3 deprecated API warnings, and fix ARIA required children. These drive Best Practices 81/100 down despite Accessibility 95/100.
